notes.title: Black screen repair
notes.notes: Fix the bug of black screen in the final battle of LeiLei's ending.

notes.title: Add an ending hint
notes.notes: Hint icons have been added next to each ending in the plot tree. Click on the icon to view the conditions for achieving that ending.

notes.title: Repair subtitles
notes.notes: The problem of abnormal subtitle display in different time zones has been fixed.

notes.title: Function optimization
notes.notes:
Update content:

1.Optimize the coin game. The victory condition has been changed from the original "7 times" to "6 times".
2.The "Skip" function has been added to the interactive sessions (fun games, puzzles, QTE, etc.) after they are completed.
